SELECT DISTINCT
    r."name" AS restaurant_name,
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."food_service") = 'cafe'
    AND LOWER(r."cuisine") = 'italian'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r."name" AS restaurant_name,
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."food_service") != 'cafe' OR LOWER(r."food_service") IS NULL;

SELECT
    "its"."name" AS "support_specialist_name",
    STRING_AGG("s"."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY "s"."system_name") AS "systems"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" "its"
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" "itss" ON "its"."id" = "itss"."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" "s" ON "itss"."system_id" = "s"."system_id"
GROUP BY
    "its"."id", "its"."name";

SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
LEFT JOIN
    it_support_specialists_systems itss ON its.id = itss.it_specialist_id
LEFT JOIN
    systems s ON itss.system_id = s.system_id
ORDER BY
    its.id, s.system_name;

WITH internship_responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total_count FROM "internships"
)
SELECT
    r."responsibility"
FROM
    internship_responsibility_counts r
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships t
WHERE
    r.internship_count = t.total_count;

SELECT
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%разработчик%'
    OR LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%программист%'
    OR LOWER("position"."description") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."description") LIKE '%разработчик%'
    OR LOWER("position"."description") LIKE '%программист%';

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs")
LIMIT 1;
